association_review.review_basis: Claim 1 identifies this exact route and action. Live SaveSelection constructs the selection command and awaits its injected handler. The remaining claims cover source-reviewed authorization, candidate registration, positional inputs, authentication guard, distinct selection lists and flag updates, and state restoration/save. This association is useful for following selection-saving behavior; the map does not establish compiler binding, cache expiry or key format, malformed-JSON recovery, shared/durable storage, or runtime success.
